How do I rotate my API keys without incurring downtime?

To rotate your API keys with zero downtime:
1. Navigate to Settings > API & Security.
2. Click 'Generate Secondary Key'.
3. Update your microservices with the secondary key.
4. Verify telemetry logs for successful traffic on the secondary key.
5. Click 'Revoke Primary Key'. The secondary key immediately becomes primary.

What happens if our account exceeds its monthly egress limit?

When your account reaches 90% of its monthly egress quota, administrators receive an automated alert. If you exceed 100%, traffic is not throttled; additional bandwidth is billed at the standard overage rate of $0.05 per gigabyte at the end of the billing cycle.

Can I configure custom DNS nameservers for our private VPC?

Yes. Open Networking > VPCs > Select VPC > DHCP Options. Set 'Domain Name Servers' to your internal resolvers (comma-separated IPv4 addresses) and save. Connected VM instances will adopt the new DNS configuration on their next DHCP lease renewal.

We need SOC2 Type II compliance reports for our annual audit. Where can we download them?

Compliance reports including SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001, and HIPAA BAA templates are accessible directly in the Trust Portal under Organization > Compliance & Trust. An organization Owner role is required to sign the standard NDA prior to download.

How do I restore a database from an automated point-in-time snapshot?

1. Navigate to Databases > Managed Clusters and select your cluster.
2. Click the 'Snapshots & Restores' tab.
3. Choose 'Point-in-Time Recovery' and select your target timestamp within the 35-day retention window.
4. Name the new target cluster and click 'Provision Restore'. The original cluster remains completely untouched.

Does AcmeCloud support SAML 2.0 Single Sign-On with Okta and Google Workspace?

Yes, Enterprise tier plans include SAML 2.0 SSO with Just-In-Time (JIT) user provisioning. You can configure Okta, Google Workspace, Azure AD, or any standard IdP metadata URL under Settings > Single Sign-On.

Why is my ingress traffic blocked on port 443?

Check your VPC Security Groups and Network ACLs. Ensure an inbound rule exists allowing TCP traffic on port 443 from CIDR 0.0.0.0/0 (or your allowed source subnet). Also verify that your instance has a public IP or is registered behind an active Load Balancer.

What is the policy for invoice refunds?

Prepaid compute credits are refundable within 14 calendar days of transaction if unused. Billed hourly usage for compute, storage, and egress is non-refundable once consumed. Submit refund inquiries through Billing > Support Ticket with your invoice ID.

How do I configure mutual TLS (mTLS) on an Application Load Balancer?

Under Load Balancers > Listeners, select HTTPS:443. Enable 'Client Certificate Negotiation', upload your root CA and intermediate certificate trust store in PEM format, and choose your certificate revocation list (CRL) synchronization interval.

Can we pin CPU architecture to AMD EPYC instead of Intel Xeon?
Yes. When launching instances or updating Auto-Scaling templates, select instance series with the 'a' suffix (e.g., c6a.2xlarge, m6a.4xlarge) to guarantee AMD EPYC 4th Gen hardware allocation.
